decisions.statement: A recording that changes nothing is written nowhere.
A write starts only once the recording has settled.
A recording inside the settle restarts the settle rather than joining the write.
Writes run in turn rather than at once.
A refused write leaves the last written state where that state was.
State that did not land is written again by the next write.
A write goes to the one write the pages service answers.
The page a write is for is named in that write's body rather than in its URL.
A write merges, so the first write of a window makes that window's page.
A window's slug opens with a word, because a name opening with a digit is no slug.
A writer is named as a name and an address, which is the only form a write takes.
Every value a write carries is uncommitted, so no observation enters a commit.
Every feature's observation goes as one document rather than field by field.
A store writes through the fetch its caller named and through no other road.
A store naming no fetch has its observations and writes nowhere.
A store that writes nowhere settles nothing and starts no timer.
Disposing asks for the last write.
Everything recorded inside the last settle lands before disposing returns.
The time on an observation is asked of the clock the caller named.
One store is held for the extension and reached by name rather than passed.
Recording before a store is set is dropped rather than refused.
Nothing here defers a commit.
No child process is started here.

definition: each feature's last observation held for one window, and the settled write that lands it
